subject: german
general_outcomes: By the end of Junior School, the learner should be able to:
communicate information effectively about everyday issues.
listen actively to varied speakers in varied contexts and respond appropriately.
read varied simple texts on familiar matters for information and enjoyment.
interact with others on familiar topics in a simple manner.
write simple texts on subject matter relating to their everyday experiences.
use varied media to access and create information to enhance German language learning.
appreciate own and other people’s culture for national cohesion and international consciousness.
apply acquired knowledge and skills to address challenges in everyday life.
